title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a festive 1982 show with Jerry’s standout West L.A. Fadeaway vocal and a powerful second set, though Brent‑sung “Far From Me” disappoints.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the band’s energy shine through, especially on the soaring West L.A. Fadeaway and a punchy Truckin' that even swaps Sweet Jane lyrics for a wild twist. The second set is described as powerful and historic, while the Brent Mydland‑led “Far From Me” draws criticism. Overall the performance is celebrated as another classic Dead night.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise the musical performance and soundboard clarity, noting several standout moments; minor criticism of one song does not outweigh overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the soundboard capture "nice" and "great", noting clear, fun‑filled audio with no reported dropouts or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festive, historic night with a solid first half and a powerful, memorable second set that keeps the energy high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal on West L.A. Fadeaway is highlighted as possibly his best early‑80s performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Referred to as "Classic Bobby," indicating a solid contribution during the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland is praised for settling in and enhancing the band's sound, though his lead on “Far From Me” is criticized.
